name: Laws of Fiji (consolidated Acts and subsidiary legislation)
label: Fiji
record_note: laws.gov.fj publishes only the current consolidation, so each law has one version here: the text as of its last-update date. Earlier text is not available; history notes and Tables of Amendments are kept as text and in data/amendments.csv.

dates.commit: consolidation date (laws.gov.fj last-update date of each law)

author.consolidated: Laws of Fiji (Office of the Attorney-General)
author.unexplained: Laws of Fiji (Office of the Attorney-General)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Fiji; savings and transitional rules are in the amending laws

default_reach.meaning: a written law is presumed not to affect rights acquired, or proceedings pending, before it took effect unless it says so; on repeal, see the savings rules of the Interpretation Act
default_reach.authority: common-law presumption; Interpretation Act 1967 (Fiji), section 11 (effect of amendments) and section 18 (effect of repealing written law)
